description: This file defines the 'PhotoLibraryService' class which implements media handling functionalities related to accessing and encoding photos from the device's photo library using the Photos framework. It manages photo fetch limits, image resizing, quality adjustments, and encoding to ensure payloads stay within WebSocket size constraints.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A final class responsible for fetching, resizing, and encoding photos from the device's photo library, adhering to payload size constraints for WebSocket transfer.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos based on specified parameters, encoding them into payloads while respecting payload size limits.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks the current authorization status for photo library access.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Handles the process of rendering a PHAsset into an image, resizing, and re-encoding it to meet size constraints.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a UIImage into JPEG data, adjusting quality and size to stay within a specified Base64 size budget.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a target width while maintaining aspect ratio.
